content.value: An outward flow reaction turbine has a speed of 300 rpm and a constant breadth of 30 cm. The diameter of the wheel at inlet and outlet are 1.25 m and 2.5 m respectively. The wheel works under a head of 45 m and discharges 6 m3/sec. If the hydraulic efficiency is 89%, calculate the angles of the blades and guide vanes.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2019
